To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Technology Entrepreneurship is the entrepreneurial process of the creation of new ventures that are based on technological opportunities and that have a high technological intensity.
Technology Entrepreneurship is about the entrepreneurial exploitation and renewal of technological knowledge in the formation and growth of technology-based new ventures.
Technology Entrepreneurship is the process by which individuals, organizations and systems create and develop technological opportunities into new products and services and new ventures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the formation, exploitation and development of technology-based ventures and the conditions that enable them to succeed.
the formation, exploitation and the renewal of technological opportunities by entrepreneurs and the firms that they found.

the entrepreneurial processes that lead to the creation of new products and new firms, as well as with the entrepreneurial activities that lead to the renewal of products and firms in a dynamic technological environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

“Technology Entrepreneurship refers to the process of creating a new technology-based firm, exploiting a technology-based opportunity, and renewing a technology-based firm in order to create economic value.”

“technology entrepreneurship is a research stream that focuses on the formation, exploitation and the renewal of technology-based firms and their products and services, which are based on a technology and a technology-related market, and are embedded in a technology-related system”.
Technology Entrepreneurship is the entrepreneurial process that leads to the creation, growth and development of new ventures that exploit technology and innovation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the field of Technology Entrepreneurship is concerned with the entrepreneurial activities of individuals and firms that are involved with technological innovations in their formation, exploitation and/or renewal.
Technology Entrepreneurship is about entrepreneurial action in a technological environment.
Technology Entrepreneurship is about the creation of new ventures that exploit technological opportunities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Technology Entrepreneurship is not only about technology but about technology in combination with entrepreneurship.

the field of Technology Entrepreneurship has not only developed into an independent field of research, but has also evolved from a rather descriptive and normative approach to an increasingly analytical and theoretical one.
Technology Entrepreneurship is an emerging research stream that has developed into a field of its own, but that is still in its infancy.
